brief:
Gaza's Interior and National Security Ministry condemned the death of Colonel Jamal Abu Kameel, director of Gaza provincial police, who was killed in an airstrike that struck his vehicle on Rashid Street in Gaza City, Shehab Wire reported. The strike also left two of his accompanying officers wounded.

The ministry described the killing as a serious escalation and evidence of a deliberate effort to target police operations across the territory. Officials did not immediately specify who carried out the airstrike or provide further details about the circumstances surrounding the strike on Rashid Street.
